title: customer-escalation-war-room-acme-payments-2026-04-02-notes
body:
Goal: triage the failure mode impacting Acme Payments' realtime authorization flow and align on immediate mitigation + 24h runbook.

Attendees (prelim): Maya (owner), Jordan (SRE), Ava (Platform eng), Liam (CS), Priya (Account exec - FYI), Eng on-call TBD

Background / impact:
- Since 2026-04-01 23:45 UTC Acme has seen ~12% error rate on authorizations proxied through Redwood host-api route `payments-auth-v2`.
- Customer reports intermittent 500s and increased latency (p95 spikes from 120ms -> 1.2s). High business impact: payment timeouts cause checkout failures.
- They are on Dedicated cluster (us-west-2) pinned to model-id: rdm/small-deploy-2026-02. Not using caching.

Hypothesis list (quick):
1) KV/Prefix cache mismatch after autoscaler event -> cold KV hot reload causing extra latency and transient 500s.
2) Model variant fallback triggered (quantized variant) due to capacity constraints -> incompatibility with request headers leading to unhandled code path.
3) Networking (NLB) healthcheck flapping -> connection resets to runtime.
4) Client payloads hitting an unexpected sequence-length distribution causing OOM/GRPC errors in some runtime nodes.

Pre-meeting checklist (Maya):
- Fetch latest host-api logs + error signatures (stack traces, request ids) - Jordan (in progress)
- Check Dedicated cluster autoscaler events and instance churn - Ava (todo)
- Ask Acme for request samples/ids and time window (23:30-00:30) - Liam (sent request)
- Pull model serving metrics (kv-hit-rate, cache-pop, runtime OOMs) - Jordan

Agenda (30-45m):
1) Quick context + customer impact (5m)
2) Share live logs & error signatures (10m)
3) Triage hypotheses: which data confirms/rejects (15m)
4) Decide immediate mitigation(s) and owner (10m)
5) Postmortem/next steps & comms plan (5m)

Notes to self (shorthand):
- if KV cold-starts true -> enable aggressive prefix warm cache for acme route + temporary cache prefill from sampled requests. Need a way to prefill without leaking PII (hash keys).
- If model fallback true -> bump capacity for dedicated pool or pin to non-quantized variant for Acme until fixed. Check rollback path.
- If NLB health check -> check SRE network team for recent deploys or NLB config drift.

Quick log excerpts (paste when available):
- ERROR runtime: kv_pop failed key=acct_XXXXX err=cache-miss (timestamp) request_id=...
- 500 grpc: "Runtime OOM" node=redwood-dedicated-07
- 502 upstream reset by peer for connection id=...

Immediate mitigations to propose (candidate list):
- Roll forward: temporarily pin Acme to model variant `rdm/small-deploy-2026-02-stable` (no fallback) - Pros: fast; Cons: capacity hit.
- Warm prefix cache for recent keys for 24h window + enable auto-prefill for route - low risk but needs code path and permission.
- Scale up dedicated pool by +2 nodes (us-west-2) and prevent autoscaler from preempting for 2h - quick but costs money.
- Apply client-side retry guidance (increase timeout to 3s) and short-circuit duplicate requests - requires comms to Acme.

Decision criteria for war-room:
- If logs show OOM/grpc errors on runtime nodes -> scale up + pin variant.
- If logs show kv cold misses correlated to autoscaler events -> prefer cache prefill + small scale-up.
- If NLB resets found -> SRE to triage and rollback recent infra deploys.

Action items (short):
action_items: Jordan: collect and paste first 200 error log lines + top 10 request_ids into this doc - due 2026-04-02 10:00 UTC
Ava: check autoscaler events + node churn for dedicated-us-west-2 cluster (past 48h) - due 2026-04-02 10:30 UTC
Liam: get anonymized request samples from Acme (with timestamps) and confirm customer-side retry/timeouts - due 2026-04-02 09:45 UTC
Maya: prep communications template for Acme (acknowledgement + ETA) and coordinate post-call summary - due 2026-04-02 12:00 UTC
SRE on-call (assign during call): investigate NLB healthchecks and recent infra deploys - initial findings due 2026-04-02 11:00 UTC
Platform Eng (Ava/Jordan): if confirmed runtime OOMs, execute +2 node scale-up and pin Acme to stable variant - coordinate change window and rollback plan - target within 2 hours of call
All: update this doc with any new evidence; tag #acme-escalations Slack thread for real-time updates
open_questions:
- Do we have a safe prefill mechanism that doesn't require customer consent?
- Can we temporarily route Acme traffic to another region if capacity in us-west-2 is constrained? (billing/latency concerns)
- Who owns final postmortem write-up and timeline? (suggest: Maya + Jordan + Liam)
next_meeting: Standup in 2 hours (2026-04-02 11:00 UTC) if incident persists; else 24h follow-up for postmortem assignment
notes_footer: Informal notes: keep this doc editable — will convert to confluence page after triage. Preserve raw logs / request ids in a secure place (S3 restricted) not here.
